title.en: What the Flow control valve outline cannot add to concrete pump cutting ring
title.zh: 《流量控制阀门》的大纲不能给混凝土泵切割环加数字

description.en: Section titles come from Flow control valve; the concrete pump cutting ring figures stay the printed ones. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai names the cutting ring on the published daily checklist as something to observe with the S-valve. No outer diameter, carbide grade or replacement hour is printed for it, and there is no separate product page that assigns a size. The published spare on the same circuit is the S-tube seal kit. Not printed, so left blank: cylinder bore, piston stroke, service life, a material grade number.
description.zh: 节标题来自《流量控制阀门》，混凝土泵切割环的数字仍是已印数字。邢台河北品锦机械在已发布的每日点检里，把切割环和 S 阀一起列为观察项。没有印出外径、硬质合金牌号或更换小时，也没有单独的产品页指定尺寸。同一回路上已公布的配件是 S 管密封套件。没有印出、因此留空的栏目：缸径、活塞行程、使用寿命、材料牌号。

question.en: Where does the photograph sit relative to the printed concrete pump cutting ring cells?
question.zh: 这张配图相对混凝土泵切割环的已印格子处于什么位置？

answer.en: The published table prints Part type S-tube large-end and small-end seal kit; Large-end sizes listed φ210 / φ220 / φ250 (set; some six-piece); Small-end sizes listed φ80 / φ90 / φ100 / φ105; Unit Set. Those seal-kit cells belong to the S-tube seal page. They are not a size for the cutting ring. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 已公布参数表印有：配件类型S管大端与小端密封套件；已列大端尺寸φ210 / φ220 / φ250（套；部分为六件套）；已列小端尺寸φ80 / φ90 / φ100 / φ105；单位套。这些密封套件格子属于 S 管密封页，不是切割环的尺寸。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。
